title: Hyundai Motor Company newsroom - 2023 IONIQ 6 leads new era of electrification at 2022 Automobility Los Angeles (US spec)
notes: US-spec 2023 IONIQ 6: 77.4 kWh pack, 10.9 kW onboard charger, 10-80 % about 18 min on a 350 kW charger; battery heater warms the pack before fast charging, starts automatically when a charging stop is entered in navigation, or manually via the MyHyundai app while plugged in. Does not give a DC peak kW, usable kWh or the port type.
